The house

Three generations, one stubborn starter

Marcel started with a borrowed oven in 1991. His granddaughter runs it today and the levain — begun in 1974 — still gets fed twice a day.

We mill in small batches, ferment cold and refuse to rush. If a dough is not ready, the shelf stays half empty and we say so at the counter.

Everything is written twice: once on the slate behind the till, once here — in your language, with the same prices.

“Good bread is a promise kept every morning.”
